slides.question: Keeper problem or defence problem?

concept: A chaotic 2-2 needs sorting, so the carousel splits the night into two suspects. The hero stacks the chaos in grey (three penalties, two goals ruled out) and lands the result in white: still no first win. Slide 2 is the keeper's charge sheet, read like a match log with minute stamps (one save, two costly mistakes). Slide 3 is the officials' log: the two United goals that didn't count and the late red. Slide 4 zooms out to one giant number, 7 straight games conceding two or more, to show this isn't one bad night. The last slide turns to the table and hands fans the debate: keeper or defence. Football green, type and pitch graphics only: no player photos, no club crests.
caption:
Three penalties. Two goals ruled out. Still no first win for Pochettino.

Sporting 2-2 Manchester United in Lisbon. Senne Lammens saved Luis Suárez's first penalty, then gave away a second one moments later. Bruno Fernandes turned it round with two goals in two minutes after half-time (one a penalty). Then Lammens missed an 80th-minute cross and Suárez equalised into an empty net.

United thought they had won it on 82 minutes when Kaique turned a corner into his own net, but VAR ruled it out for Patrick Dorgu's foul on the keeper. Amad also had a goal chalked off before half-time. Youri Tielemans was sent off in stoppage time.

Opta Analyst says United have now conceded two or more in seven straight games, their first run like that since 1977. They sit 19th in the league phase on 7 points. Brentford are next on Saturday.
